sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:22

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:22:1
items.html: Ten lights, but the vessel was made all at once: For with respect to the vessel all these departures are counted as one departure, since there is here as yet nothing but one vessel, which is the vessel of Malchut alone, and there is no aspect of recognition of a vessel in the first nine Sefirot at all. And all these goings out and comings in that were made in her are discerned as one long vessel whose parts are not equal, as the ARI says above in item 19. And know that all these are preparations for the correction of ten vessels in ten Sefirot. And the matters proceed by degrees: that in the first expansion of AK no recognition was yet made by the departure even in the discernment of the lights, and it was not recognisable that they are ten lights; and in the second expansion a recognition was made in the ten Sefirot, that they are ten lights; and in the expansion of the ten Sefirot in the world of Nekudim a recognition of ten vessels was made in the GAR, but not in the seven lower Sefirot; and in the world of Atzilut the matter was completed, and ten complete vessels were made in all ten Sefirot. As written in its place.
